severity.description: block = the PR waits; warn = it lands and History says so; info = recorded only

owner.description: who evaluates it: the console now, axf-molly once the container owns the gate

on.description: ci: which commit the checks must be green on

redJoins.description: ci: a red PR still joins a batch (the batch run is the gate)

noRunMin.description: ci: minutes with no run before the lander starts one

commands.description: tests: the commands run after generated files were resolved

check.description: theme / controls / custom: the repo-relative check script

holdOn.description: ui-review: the UI Review states that hold a PR

autoResolve.description: clash: conflict kinds the lander resolves itself

fileFix.description: clash: a code conflict files a fix (agent job) instead of waiting

autoLand.description: merge-queue-only: the builds round (clean, merge main, push, open the PR) runs

directMerge.description: merge-queue-only: false = nothing but the lander merges

maxAttempts.description: auto-lander: failures of one kind (clash, red-ci, land) on one build before it escalates

backoff.description: auto-lander: minutes before the next try after the n-th failure, min(maxMin, baseMin × factor^(n−1))

attemptTimeoutMin.description: auto-lander: a started attempt older than this counts as a timeout

mergeMain.description: auto-lander: a clash merges main into the branch by itself

fixSessions.description: auto-lander: red CI starts a fix session by itself

escalateTo.description: auto-lander: where maxAttempts reached is reported

source.description: today's setting or check this rule replaced (push banner config.json key, CI job)
